建威、西郡太守索泮；建節將軍
幾將一紀；眾渴死者十二三
從陝北渡；遣沖率見眾為先驅，自繁川趣長安；清水之格奴阪
忍生靈之命，疑猛獸之朝饑

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 殺洛於西海，以子胤為鷹揚將軍，率眾五萬距光於酒泉。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 以子胤為鷹揚將軍 then 率眾五萬 assigns the fifty thousand to Yin, not Liang Xi (熙). Literal before wrongly makes Xi lead the host.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 胤及光戰于安彌，為光所敗。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 胤 is Liang Xi's son from s0043; Fu Yin is unsupported. Idiomatic before mis-surnames him.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 建威、西郡太守索泮，奮威、督洪池已南諸軍事、酒泉太守宋皓等，並為光所殺。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 建威 is Suo Pan's title, paired with 西郡太守, not a commandery named Jianwei.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 建威、西郡太守索泮，奮威、督洪池已南諸軍事、酒泉太守宋皓等，並為光所殺。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same list structure; idiomatic before obscures 建威 as a military office.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 興遣建節將軍、臨清柏衛平率其宗人千七百夜擊廣軍，大敗之。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 臨清柏衛平 is surname 柏 with given name 衛平; 建節將軍 is a title, not lineage.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 興遣建節將軍、臨清柏衛平率其宗人千七百夜擊廣軍，大敗之。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same unit; idiomatic truncates 柏衛平 to Bai Wei and mistranslates 建節.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 袍罕諸氐皆窘於兵革而疲不堪命，乃殺興，推衛平為使持節、安西將軍、河州刺史，遣使請命。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 衛平 continues 柏衛平 from s0082; not a person surnamed Wei.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 袍罕諸氐皆窘於兵革而疲不堪命，乃殺興，推衛平為使持節、安西將軍、河州刺史，遣使請命。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same identification as tr-007.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 枹罕諸氐以衛平年老，不可以成事業，議廢之，而憚其宗強，連日不決。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 衛平 again refers to Bai Weiping established at s0082.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 枹罕諸氐以衛平年老，不可以成事業，議廢之，而憚其宗強，連日不決。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same as tr-009.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 衛公朽耄，不足以成大事，宜反初服，以避賢路，狄道長苻登雖王室疏屬，而志略雄明，請共立之，以赴大駕。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 衛公 is the honorific address for the same 衛平/Bai Weiping; English before as Wei Ping is misleading but the proposed after correctly names Bai Weiping.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 父敞，健之世為太尉司馬、隴東太守、建節將軍，後為苻生所殺。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 建節將軍 is a military title; establishes the standard, not lineage.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 父敞，健之世為太尉司馬、隴東太守、建節將軍，後為苻生所殺。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same title error in idiomatic field.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 登既代衛平，遂專統征伐。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 衛平 is Bai Weiping per s0082.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 登既代衛平，遂專統征伐。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same as tr-014.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 賊虜未平，不可宗室之中自為仇敵，原大王遠蹤光武推聖公之義，梟二虜之後，徐更圖之。」
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 聖公 is the Gengshi Emperor (Liu Xuan) in the Guangwu parallel, not a Duke of Geng.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 賊虜未平，不可宗室之中自為仇敵，原大王遠蹤光武推聖公之義，梟二虜之後，徐更圖之。」
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same 聖公 surface; idiomatic the Geng emperor is insufficient.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 臣兄襄從陝北渡，假路求西，狐死首丘，欲暫見鄉里。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 從陝北渡 is crossing northward from Shan; before invents south of Shan as the starting point.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 臣兄襄從陝北渡，假路求西，狐死首丘，欲暫見鄉里。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same directional error in idiomatic field.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 遣沖率見眾為先驅，自繁川趣長安。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Succeeds s0218 where Fu Deng (登) is subject; idiomatic before drops Deng and collapses two actions.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 萇遣其將軍王破虜略地秦州，楊定及破虜戰于清水之格奴阪，大敗之。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 格奴阪 is a slope (阪); idiomatic ford is incorrect. Literal already has Slope.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 登聞之，秣馬萬兵，告堅神主曰：「曾孫登自受任執戈，幾將一紀，未嘗不上天錫祐，皇鑒垂矜，所在必克，賊旅冰摧。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 幾將一紀 is nearly one twelve-year cycle, not exactly twelve years as idiomatic before states.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 登爭水不得，眾渴死者十二三。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: 十二三 is two or three tenths (十之二三), not twelve or thirteen parts.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 登爭水不得，眾渴死者十二三。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same fraction; idiomatic two men in three greatly overstates casualties.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 健既承家，克隆凶緒，率思歸之眾，投山西之隙，據億丈之岩險，總三秦之果銳，敢窺大寶，遂竊鴻名，校數奸雄，有可言矣。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Owner reason cites 疏爵以侯楚材，築館以須歸命, but those phrases are not in s0318; they appear in s0330. Proposed after would import text from a different unit.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 忍生靈之命，疑猛獸之朝饑。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: In Fu Sheng's condemnation, 忍 means hard-hearted toward the people, not sparing them.

translationRepairDecisions.sourceZh: 忍生靈之命，疑猛獸之朝饑。
translationRepairDecisions.rationale: Same semantic reversal in idiomatic field.
